## The defect

On 2026-09-21 two review dispatches died on their first request with HTTP 429 「You've reached your Fable limit」; the `domain:spec` seat asked, the maintainer answered 「fable 没有了」, and #19544 / PR #19573 (`77df0f6`) moved `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` from `claude-fable-5-1` to `claude-opus-5`, added `RETIRED_TIER_WORDS = ['fable']` with a retired-spelling guard, and reworded `references/contract-review.md:60`. The maintainer's word today: that was one agent's **temporary lack of authorization**, ⛔ not a retirement of the model, and it must not have changed the skills. The contract-review tier is fable.

## What lands — `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` only (not governed; the seat lands it through the queue)

1. `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER = 'claude-fable-5-1'`; `TIER_CEILING` derives to the fable word again — ladder floor sonnet · default opus · ceiling fable, as it read before PR #19573.
2. `RETIRED_TIER_WORDS = Object.freeze([])` — no tier word is retired. The retired-spelling guard stays; its non-vacuity pin (around :25479–:25481, 「names at least one word」) is re-pinned to hold on an EMPTY list: the control becomes 「a word that IS in the ladder can never appear in the list」, proved on a mutated copy rather than on the live list.
3. The docblock beside the constants carries the maintainer's principle, quoting the three sentences with their date: a tier word is retired only by the maintainer's explicit ruling that names a retirement; a 429 or a missing authorization on one session is ⛔ not a retirement; a seat not served at the tier renders the review through an isolated at-tier subagent (`model: fable`) or waits outside the queue — ⛔ never by changing a constant. (`references/contract-review.md`'s 降档保险丝 section is deleted by #19061 step ② per the maintainer's 「不留」 on this date, and SKILL.md:516 makes this file the single source of tier values — so this docblock is the principle's home.)
4. Every self-test pin PR #19573 added that asserts the opus value, the non-empty retired list, or 「the contract-review tier sits at the default-tier constant」 is inverted or retired with its reason named; the ladder render, exits, clause-② note and suspicion line read the constant, so they follow.
5. ⛔ Not touched: `.claude/**` (step ② of #19061 owns the reference text); `scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs:848` (already lists the fable id); any workflow.
